description: Create a normal SIMcloud account under the authenticated account for a client application user. Confirm that the person consents to account creation and that their cell number, email and password are correct before calling. The response contains the child account API token, which must be stored securely and used only for that child account.

cell.description: 10-digit South African mobile number beginning with 0.

id_number.description: Optional valid South African ID number.

password.description: The new user's SIMcloud login password. Do not log or display it after this call.

name: register_simcloud_user

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Register a SIMcloud user
